# `String` and `Builder`

Edva separates text and byte buffers into two paired types:
- **`String`**: Immutable, NUL-reserved 16-byte fat pointer `{ i64 len, ptr data }` with arena generation-tag safety.
- **`Builder`**: Mutable, growable 24-byte arena buffer `{ i64 len, ptr data, i64 cap }` that freezes into a `String` in $O(1)$ via unary `+b`.

## Architecture and ABI comparison

| Property | `String` | `Builder` |
|---|---|---|
| **Runtime layout** | `{ i64 len, ptr data }` (16 bytes) | `{ i64 len, ptr data, i64 cap }` (24 bytes) |
| **Mutability** | Strictly immutable (`s(0) = x` rejected) | Mutable in place (`+=`, `= (...)`, `?b = n`, `@[&b] = x`) |
| **NUL-reserved tail** | Guaranteed `data[len] == '\0'` on whole strings | Guaranteed upon `+b` freeze |
| **Generation tag** | Upper 16 bits of `len` (`len >> 48`); traps with `E4010` on stale read | Allocated in active arena |
| **Aliasing semantics** | Value descriptor sharing immutable bytes | Shared descriptor until `+b` detaches buffer and resets descriptor to `{0, null, 0}` |

## `String` literals, margin stripping, and interpolation

| Feature | Syntax | Specification | Diagnostic |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Single-line literal** | `"Hello\n\t\"world\""` | Supports `\n`, `\t`, `\r`, `\0`, `\a`, `\b`, `\f`, `\v`, `\e`, `\"`, `\'`, `\\`, `\$`, `\xHH`, `\u{HEX}` | `E1003` / `E1006` |
| **Multi-line literal** | `"` followed immediately by `\n` | Strips opening `\n` and strips the first content line's leading indentation (**baseline margin**) from all lines | `E1017`: line indented less than baseline margin |
| **Line continuation** | Trailing `\` before `\n` | Suppresses newline while maintaining baseline margin stripping on the next line | — |
| **Closing quote placement** | Own line vs end of content line | Closing `"` on its own line preserves trailing `\n`; closing `"` at end of text omits trailing `\n` | — |
| **Interpolation (`${...}`)** | `"val = ${x + 1}"` | Lowers to `%to_str(expr)` for `String`, `Rune`, integers, and floats; in `b += "..."`, streams directly into `b` without intermediate allocations | `E3105`: non-scalar in `${...}` |

```{.dva .run}
#use io

user = "Alice"
items = 3
doc = "
   User: ${user}
   Count: ${items}
   "
io::out $ doc
```

## Arena generation tags and stale-read protection (`E4010`)

| Mechanism | Specification |
|---|---|
| **Tag encoding** | Upper 16 bits of the 64-bit `len` word (`len >> 48`) store the arena scope generation; actual byte length is `len & 0x0000FFFFFFFFFFFF` |
| **Tag `0` (Immortal)** | String literals and top-level allocations outside restore scopes carry tag `0` and never expire |
| **Active scope validation** | Scoped arena restores track active generation IDs (`1..65535`, wrapping to `1` and skipping active IDs). Reading a `String` whose tag is no longer active traps with `E4010` |
| **FFI pointer masking** | `&s` returns the raw `data` pointer directly (`NUL`-terminated); `%ptrmask` is available for tagged raw addresses |

## `String` and `Builder` operations

| Operation | Syntax | Operand | Result Type | Semantics |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Byte length** | `?s` / `?b` | `String` / `Builder` | `Int` | Number of UTF-8 bytes currently stored (`.len` is rejected with `E3065`) |
| **Rune count** | `??s` | `String` | `Int` | Number of UTF-8 Unicode codepoints |
| **Data pointer** | `&s` / `&b` | `String` / `Builder` | `Addr` | Raw pointer to byte buffer (`&s` is NUL-terminated for C FFI) |
| **Byte index** | `s(i)` | `String`, `i: Int` | `Int` | Unsigned byte value (`0..255`) at `i` (aborts on out-of-bounds) |
| **Substring slice** | `s(a..b)` / `s(a...b)` | `String`, range | `String` | Zero-copy sub-range view (`a..`, `..b`, `-k..` supported) |
| **Concatenation** | `s1 + s2` / `s + byte_or_rune` | `String` | `String` | Allocates concatenated `String` in arena |
| **Segment equality** | `s == ("pre", mid, "suf")` | `String`, tuple of `String` | `<>` | Zero-allocation length + segment memory comparison |
| **Allocate Builder** | `b = {cap}` | `cap: Int` | `Builder` | Allocates mutable arena buffer with initial capacity `cap` |
| **Single append** | `b += x` | `x`: `String`, `Rune`, or byte `Int` | `()` | Appends string bytes, 1–4 UTF-8 rune bytes, or 1 byte (`0..255`) in place |
| **Peephole chain append** | `b += s1 + s2 + s3` | `String` chain | `()` | Flattens into sequential in-place appends without intermediate `String` allocation |
| **Tuple mass-append** | `b += (a, b, c)` or `b = (a, b, c)` | Tuple of `String`/`Rune`/`Int` | `()` | Pre-computes total byte length, reserves capacity once, and writes all items contiguously |
| **Set Builder length** | `?b = new_len` | `Builder`, `new_len: Int` | `()` | Sets written byte length (`0 <= new_len <= cap`; aborts with `E4008` if out of bounds) |
| **Copy-and-append** | `b + x` | `Builder`, `x` | `Builder` | Clones `b` and appends `x`, leaving `b` unchanged |
| **Deep copy** | `++s` / `++b` | `String` / `Builder` | Same | Allocates an independent arena copy of the buffer |
| **Freeze Builder** | `+b` | `Builder` | `String` | Writes trailing `\0`, transfers buffer to `String` in $O(1)$, and resets `b` (and any aliases) to `{0, null, 0}` |

```{.dva .run}
#use io

b = {64}
b += ("SELECT ", "id, name", " FROM users WHERE active = ", '1)
query = +b

io::out $ query
io::out $ (?query, ?b, query(0..6))
```
